parameters: harness test value (large-artery order; chosen so R/I and 1/sqrt(IC) are non-stiff)
harness test value (rho l / A for a ~5 cm, r ~1.25 cm segment)
harness test value (circulatory_autogen 0D_1D_coupling_test); an area of 10 cm^2

invariants.description: static pressure at the interface is total minus dynamic pressure, P_s* = P_t* − ½ρ(q*/A*)²
flux is the time integral of ρ q* (trapezoidal integral of the output, relative error < 1e-3)
steady state: q* satisfies the analytic balance R q* = P_in − P_t* + ½ρ(q*/A*)² of the harness (P_in = 2000 Pa, R = 1e7 Pa s m^-3), residual < 0.1% of P_in
steady state: q* equals the closed-form root q = (R − sqrt(R² − 2kΔP))/k, k = ρ/A*², ΔP = P_in − P_t* (0.1%)
momentum balance at steady state: interface static pressure equals the 0D pressure (P_s_0D − P_s* → 0, < 0.1 Pa)
flow into the coupler equals flow out of the 0D vessel at steady state (inflow v of vessel0d = q*, 0.1%)

bc_sweep.rationale: I spans rho l / (pi r^2) for interface segments of about 1-10 cm with radii 0.8-1.5 cm (2e4-5e5 Pa s^2 m^-6); below ~1e4 the coupler becomes stiff relative to the harness dynamics. rho spans the usual whole-blood density range 1040-1060 kg m^-3.

baseline.reason: numerical interface between a 0D and a 1D model with no physiological counterpart of its own; verified against the analytic steady state of the harness. Validation belongs to a coupled 0D-1D model.

calibrate.note: not_applicable: numerical interface component; nothing to calibrate against data on its own.
